ship.brig.world.$comment: 45 deg camera render, 96 px cell, 32 facings (art pipeline section 4; tools/art/render_brig.py). Pivot is the hull centre on the waterline: the render looked at z 0.6, which lands 0.6 * cos45 * (96 / 3.7) = 11 px below the cell centre. Set sails are drawn per point of sail and tack (_p wind from port, _s from starboard): yards braced, canvas bellied downwind; in irons two frames flap. The sea is drawn in 3D (packages/render3d): the game shows these sets only in the harbour scenes, the player's ship at anchor (sail_furled, broadside on); the rows stay in the atlas in this order, which is how the frames are found.

ship.fluyt.world.$comment: 45 deg camera render like the brig (tools/art/render_ships.py fluyt), same 23 sail anims, pivot and cell; packed into one atlas by tools/art/pack_ships.ts. mast: the head the flag streams from, in model units (forward of the pivot, up from the waterline).
